newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Power cites mild weather for Q2 drop.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Power cites mild weather for Q2 drop.

text.p: Nevada Power Co Wednesday said its drop in second quarter earnings was due chiefly to milder weather and increases in interest, operating and maintenance expenses.
Interest cost was up due to financing for infrastructure costs, while operating and maintenance expenses rose due to an accelerated maintenance schedule at certain facilities.
Earlier, Nevada Power reported second quarter net income of $18.8 million, or $0.38 a share, versus $20.2 million, or $0.42 a share, one year ago.
